fault_control: Only host0 controls the existing labeled isolated-bootstrap fixture; exact Docker executable and immutable container IDs are bound, every container is inspected before mutation, and restoration is attempted under cancellation.
latency: Every scheduled arrival enters denominator. Measurements start at scheduled arrival. Missing/censored tail samples yield an unavailable percentile, never a low percentile from only successful arrivals.
telemetry: Every per-pool and instance metric must map to an actual source-bound native exporter name. Missing, stale, ambiguous, saturated or reset telemetry fails closed. No global average substitutes for pool measurements.
slo: Read and mutation errors include dependency-fault arrivals and are reported separately; benchmark observations do not establish monthly99.95/99.9 availability.
forbidden_substitutions: calibration echo used as application gateway
source inspection used as capacity evidence
phase3 proof used as final capacity
